descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-11 Course Timeline · S01 Hospital day 2: finishing today's note adds one dated entry after yesterday's

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U1 One entry per completed visit, correctly dated, in chronological order, never duplicated. (UAT TC-11; TFA-92589 AC 3)
  • U3 Hospital: the timeline shows yesterday and today only, per the retention rules. (UAT TC-11; UAT 3.6; TFA-92589 AC 4)
  • U8 Run in both modes for one patient each: Hospital across 2 consecutive days, Nursing Home across 3+ visits. (UAT TC-11; UAT 3.3)
  • T2 A new timeline entry is created automatically on every completed note, generated from that day's finished note. (TFA-92589 AC 2; TFA-92589 description 1)

Test design technique: Happy path (happy-path) — Walk the normal flow exactly as the UAT / ticket words it; everything it names has to show up.

Given Hospital patient whose ledger holds yesterday's entry and today's pre-round line ('⏳ Encounter pending')

When Type the encounter text and tap Generate Note & Finish (model calls mocked at the socket), then open Pre-Round

Then The stored ledger is yesterday's line followed by exactly one line for today carrying the generated entry; the Hospital Course shows both cards, yesterday's first

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Playwright assertions in course-timeline.spec.ts: ledger equals '<yesterday line>\n<today>: <entry>' (one line for today, in order), both cards visible, yesterday's text before today's. The model is mocked, so this proves the ledger rules, not the AI entry (S13/S14)

Where it ran: local lane A (existing Playwright tests); test method PW · Playwright script; lane planned in the matrix: existing tests (Tim's Playwright) (automated)

S01 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-11.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: local — main e02167f, local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane A.

Test method: PW · Playwright script; secondary: AGENT · Browser agent — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on local; Source: matrix (lane A).

UAT item: TC-11 Course Timeline · Section: A2 · Pre-Round · Scenario: TC-11/S01

Hospital day 2: finishing today's note adds one dated entry after yesterday's

Tickets: TFA-92589 Course Timeline (ready for qa)

Result: passed in matrix/TC-11.results.json (lane A: the existing Playwright specs below, run on the local stack; agent-matrix.sh).

Existing specs:

  • course-timeline.spec.ts [chromium] — finishing a hospital note replaces today's pre-round line with the dated entry — expected

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — Lane A (Tim's Playwright spec in e2e/course-timeline.spec.ts, chromium): it makes a fresh @roundai.test account, seeds the ledger through e2e/support/backend.ts with the local admin key and mocks every model call at the socket; dev has no admin key, one shared account and no action mock, so it ru…. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
